limitations: No Site privacy, supported-person binding, healthcare urgency, mailbox identity or clinical escalation.
reported_constraints: No GitHub release object and no Oblivion-specific privacy or provisioning behavior.

edition_boundary.statement: Public ZoneMinder repository only; camera firmware, hosted video services and uncited ONVIF integrations are excluded.

maintenance_release_signals.statement: Default-branch head committed 2026-08-22; release 1.38.4 published 2026-08-11.

observed_behaviours.observation: Event creation persists source monitor, start time, cause and state and updates aggregate counters.

strengths: Concrete event source, time, cause and state persistence.
limitations: No retained-media claim, Site privacy, consent, retention approval or authorized human response lifecycle.
reported_constraints: Camera event persistence does not establish evidence governance or care-safety response.
